proof_0409.moves: Pure definitional unfolding: the value of expMap at a point is by construction the componentwise exponential, so the lemma is closed by rfl. No mathematical step beyond unfolding the definition of expMap and its coercion to a function.

proof_0410.moves: Says that the coercion-to-function of the constant modular form is the constant function; true by definition of ModularForm.const, closed by rfl/Eq.refl. Content is unfolding a definition through the FunLike coercion, nothing else.

proof_0411.moves: Splits (p * X) iff Splits p: commute the two factors with mul_comm and cite the already-proved X * p version. The whole argument is commutativity plus one prior lemma, with simp-generated congruence residue around it.

proof_0412.moves: If X and Y are identically distributed then so are c + X and c + Y: push the identical-distribution hypothesis through the map (c + .) using IdentDistrib.comp, discharging the required measurability of left translation.

proof_0413.moves: Smoothness of the real exponential is inherited from the complex one: cite that complex exp is C^n and transfer along the real-of-complex principle (a complex-differentiable function restricted to the reals is real-smooth).

proof_0414.moves: Iff proved by splitting into the two implications: forward, extract from IsConjRoot an algebra equivalence sending one root to the other (uses normality); backward, an algEquiv image of a root is a conjugate root, possibly after a symm. The genuine content is the two cited transfer lemmas plus destructing/exhibiting the existential witness.

proof_0415.moves: Negation of an a.e.-measurable function is a.e.-measurable: compose the (everywhere) measurable negation map with the given a.e.-measurable function.

proof_0416.moves: Standard iff-form of an extensionality lemma: forward direction is congruence (equal maps agree on every box), backward direction is the ext lemma itself. Purely structural plumbing, but that plumbing is the whole proof.

proof_0417.moves: Instance registration: preservation of the pullback of one cospan gives preservation of the pullback of the swapped cospan, by the symmetry lemma for pullback preservation applied to the existing open-immersion instance.

proof_0418.moves: Global meromorphy of a quotient is checked pointwise: unfold Meromorphic to MeromorphicAt at each point and apply the local quotient lemma. Everything else is normed-field instance bookkeeping.

proof_0419.moves: Identifies trivializationAt of a vector bundle core with the local trivialization at the index of the base point, then applies the already-proved symmL formula for localTriv. Essentially a renaming of a known lemma through the FiberBundle interface.

proof_0420.moves: Reduce global C^n smoothness to smoothness at every point via contDiff_iff_contDiffAt, then apply the pointwise product-map result at each point of the product. The rewrite is done by Eq.mpr/propext plumbing.

proof_0421.moves: Nonnegativity of the Stieltjes function built from a measurable rational CDF: feed the fact that toRatCDF satisfies IsMeasurableRatCDF into the general nonnegativity result for such Stieltjes functions.

proof_0422.moves: The chosen representative of a rational map does map to that rational map: this is exactly the specification of the classical choice made against exists_rep, i.e. Exists.choose_spec applied to the existence lemma.

proof_0423.moves: For p = infinity the eLpNorm is the essential sup, so the piecewise formula reduces immediately to the already-proved essential-sup piecewise lemma. The only step is that reduction plus citing one lemma.

proof_0424.moves: The EReal coercion of an a.e.-measurable real function is a.e.-measurable: compose the measurable coercion Real -> EReal with the given a.e.-measurable function.

proof_0425.moves: Membership in the support of a measure characterized by all neighborhoods having positive measure: instantiate the general filter-basis characterization with the tautological basis of the neighborhood filter.

proof_0426.moves: Cast the natural number to an integer and invoke the integer version of the same statement; the only real step is that the nat cast into the reals factors through the int cast.

proof_0427.moves: The coercion of a probability measure viewed as a finite measure agrees with its own coercion; true by construction of toFiniteMeasure, closed by rfl. Pure definitional unfolding through the FunLike coercion.

proof_0428.moves: A quotient of a path-connected space is path-connected: the quotient map is surjective and continuous (continuity being immediate for the coinduced topology), so transfer path-connectedness along a continuous surjection.

proof_0429.moves: Instance saying the operator norm satisfies ||1|| = 1: the unit of the continuous-linear-map ring is the identity map, whose operator norm is 1 by norm_id; wrap that in the NormOneClass constructor.

proof_0430.moves: If a set is null then its interior is empty: the interior is contained in the set, so by monotonicity it is also null; being open and null it must be empty (open-positive-measure hypothesis).

proof_0431.moves: Comap along the swap of a product: recognize swap as the measurable equivalence prodComm, whose inverse is itself, and use that comap along a measurable equivalence is map along its symm.

proof_0432.moves: Change of variables for a set lintegral along a measure-preserving measurable embedding: restrict-and-map commute (restrict_map), the lintegral transforms along the embedding (lintegral_map), and measure preservation replaces the pushforward measure by the target one. The Eq.mpr/congrArg layer is just the rewriting scaffolding.
